safetyInvariants: Media packets allow only LIKELY_BARRIER or UNCERTAIN.
Adequate alternatives and media-alternative-for-text exceptions use adequate-alternative-or-exception-observed and are not structurally barrier-ready.
Live media packets carry structural evidence and extracted media details only when the probe has an observed media content model; otherwise barriers clamp to UNCERTAIN.
Scoped 1.2.x warnings preserve their SC instead of treating every video warning as 1.2.2.
Transcript text does not satisfy scoped 1.2.2 caption adequacy.
Review-time LIKELY_BARRIER overclaims are clamped to UNCERTAIN when required structural evidence is missing.
Clean controls are review controls, not passes.
Media packets do not convert into authoritative v3 judgments.

findings.finding: Live media findings discarded load-bearing structural evidence and media details, so fixture positives could pass while live positives clamped to UNCERTAIN.
findings.remediation: runBroadScopeForUrl now emits media evidenceClaims, evidenceStrength, and evidenceDetails; buildReviewPacketsFromBroadScope preserves evidenceDetails/facts into observed.

findings.finding: Live video media findings were hard-coded to SC 1.2.2 regardless of 1.2.1 video-only, 1.2.3, or 1.2.5 scope.
findings.remediation: mediaWarningSc now preserves fixture-scoped 1.2.1/1.2.2/1.2.3/1.2.5 and falls back to warning-specific scoped SCs.

findings.finding: Caption adequacy could use nearby transcript text, falsely suppressing scoped 1.2.2 caption failures.
findings.remediation: captionAdequacy now uses caption text only; transcripts remain available for media-alternative/transcript checks but not for 1.2.2 captions.
